surface: Genuine DSH Web UI served by the official installed bundled runtime, captured page-only in Chrome on macOS via CUA. These assets do not depict native desktop window chrome.

plugin_source.kind: Local working-tree build of 0.3.1 before the release tag was created
plugin_source.verification: The hashes below identify the actual built files used by the isolated demo and can be compared against the release-tag files.

isolation: New disposable DSH_HOME and fictional Matrix-Demo workspace. No existing user profiles, session stores, API credentials, or account data were copied. Only a deliberately invalid demo API-key environment value was present; no model call was made.
conversation: Synthetic seeded session rendered through native DSH components. Displayed timing, example code values, sample checklist results, and conversation text are fictional demonstration data, not measured model output or performance.
screenshot_processing: Real page captures converted from JPEG to PNG without changing UI content, typography, layout, colors, or dimensions. Four stills are exact frames from the continuous recording; the remaining three are ordinary CUA screenshots.
native_baseline: Same fictional chat and viewport with the actual Matrix bundle toggle disabled and the isolated runtime restarted. The page was checked to have neither the Matrix active class nor its canvas before capturing. Matrix was re-enabled and the isolated runtime restarted afterward.

video.capture_api: CUA tab cdp capability: Page.startScreencast + Page.screencastFrame events + Page.screencastFrameAck

scenes.phase: active chat with native code and table

video.processing: Frame timestamps set variable-frame-rate playback; the complete requested 1440×1000 viewport is encoded without scaling. No UI edits, motion synthesis, slide interpolation, or audio.
video.encoding_note: Concat encoding repeats the final source frame once and quantizes timestamps to the input time base; it does not synthesize intermediate motion.

gif.phase: Active chat with native prose, code, table, and continuously moving rain
gif.processing: Eight seconds of the active chat phase beginning 6 seconds into the recording, sampled at 12 fps and proportionally scaled to 960 pixels wide using a 128-color palette. Actual recorded motion; no interpolated frames.

validation.actual_motion: Distinct real source frames during active chat were confirmed to differ in the visible rain margins.
validation.native_typography: Observed native prose, code syntax colors, tables, model/effort popup, appearance settings, and unsent draft remained legible. No message was sent.
validation.capture_cleanup: The temporary 1440 × 1000 viewport override was reset, the agent-created demo tab was closed, and the isolated demo server was stopped.
